title: Verify valid occurrence premium calculation returns persisted result

steps.action: Submit a valid occurrence calculation request using active rate plan and generated IDs.
steps.expected: 201 Created; response includes result_id, occurrence_id, policy_id, base_rate, calculated_premium, factors_applied, calculation_trace, created_at, is_dry_run=false, is_superseded=false.

title: Verify dry-run calculation does not persist result

steps.action: Submit dry-run request, then attempt GET by returned result_id.
steps.expected: 201 Created with full result and is_dry_run=true; GET by result_id returns 404 or no persisted DB row.

title: Verify invalid state code length is rejected

steps.action: Submit calculation with full state name or invalid state code length.
steps.expected: 400/422 validation error identifying state_code; no result persisted.

title: Verify expiration before effective date is rejected

steps.action: Submit invalid date range.
steps.expected: 400/422 validation error; no result persisted.

title: Verify base exposure must be positive

steps.action: Submit request with zero and negative exposure variants.
steps.expected: 400/422 validation error for base_exposure.

title: Verify required identifiers are validated

steps.action: Submit each missing required identifier variant.
steps.expected: 400/422 validation error identifies missing field; no result persisted.

title: Verify rate plan version must be active/resolvable

steps.action: Submit calculation with inactive/unknown rate_plan_version_id.
steps.expected: 400/404/422 per Swagger contract; no rating result is created.

title: Verify factor application order is traceable

steps.action: Submit calculation and inspect factors_applied applied_order and calculation_trace.
steps.expected: factors_applied order matches configured factor order; trace shows each factor application step.

title: Verify pro-rata calculation for endorsement

steps.action: Submit endorsement calculation with transaction_end_date.
steps.expected: 201 Created; prorated_factor and prorated_premium are populated and equal calculated_premium * factor within rounding precision.

title: Verify cancellation pro-rata calculation

steps.action: Submit cancellation request with valid transaction_end_date.
steps.expected: 201 Created; prorated fields populated; trace includes pro-rata step.

title: Verify transaction_end_date outside term is rejected

steps.action: Submit invalid transaction_end_date variants.
steps.expected: 400/422 validation error; no result persisted.

title: Verify leap-year denominator in occurrence result

steps.action: Submit calculation for leap-year term.
steps.expected: year_denominator=366, spans_leap_day=true, term_days reflects date range.

title: Verify minimum premium floor is enforced

steps.action: Submit request with low exposure or configured floor scenario.
steps.expected: calculated_premium equals configured minimum floor; trace includes minimum premium floor step.

title: Verify final rounding is to two decimal places

steps.action: Submit calculation and inspect calculated_premium/prorated_premium.
steps.expected: Monetary fields round consistently to 2 decimals per configured method; no floating-point drift.

title: Verify recalculation supersedes prior result

steps.action: Create initial result, call recalculate with changed exposure, then retrieve prior result.
steps.expected: Recalculate returns 201 with new result_id; prior result is_superseded=true and superseded_by_id=new result_id.

title: Verify get result by resultId

steps.action: Retrieve persisted occurrence result.
steps.expected: 200 OK; response result_id matches; includes factors_applied and calculation_trace.

title: Verify get by transactionId

steps.action: Retrieve result by transaction_id.
steps.expected: 200 OK; response transaction_id matches and premium fields are present.

title: Verify get all results by policyId includes history

steps.action: Retrieve policy premium history.
steps.expected: 200 OK; response array contains all matching occurrence results for tenant/policy, including superseded when applicable.

title: Verify rating.execute token cannot read monitor endpoints

steps.action: Call GET using rating.execute-only token.
steps.expected: 403 Forbidden.

title: Verify no token on calculate is unauthorized

steps.action: Submit valid request without token.
steps.expected: 401 Unauthorized; no result persisted.
